public.text: Catchment areas are presented as facility attributes enabling equity analysis. Catchments may be overlapping, dynamic, estimated, service-specific, seasonal, or affected by patient choice and transport.
public.suggestedRevision: Represent catchment definitions with method, service type, source, confidence, effective period, geometry or community list, and an indication of whether the catchment is administrative, modelled, or observed.
